# Growovo site

> Agent-native GTM operator for one-person companies: give it product facts and a growth goal; it plans, runs, and delivers daily results (execution counts, real reads, loop accountability). Phase one automates X (Twitter) + Email; other channels are gated or manual. The Chinese landing is the main page; /en.html is its English mirror. The repository is the canonical source.

Pages: / (Chinese landing: three verifiable promises, FAQ, 30-second zero-network verification, agent interfaces) · /en.html (English mirror of the same page, FAQ included).

Canonical repo and full agent entry: https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo (see repo-root llms.txt for interfaces, promise discipline and launch autopsy). Synthetic demo proves loop structure only — never reach, conversion or business outcomes.
